title: Daylio Mood Drop After Missed Breathwork
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daylio:entry
| search mood_score=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(mood_score) as avg_mood_score by _time breathwork_done
| sort - _time
description: Tracks mood after missed breathwork over time and breaks it out by breathwork flag.
value: Comparing mood with and without breathwork helps show whether the routine is actually protective.
implementation: Send mood after missed breathwork events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of mood after missed breathwork by breathwork flag.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how mood after missed breathwork changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
